_comment: Candidate display properties from the literature review (reports/AV display property literature.md). screened_in = shown to participants. render.low / render.high are the clip renderer settings (avprops/clip_render.py Style) that make the low and high clip; everything else stays at the baseline. A property with no render block cannot be made as a clip and must stay screened out.

baseline._comment: Neutral display every clip starts from: OptiCarVis expert means where available (Jansen et al., CHI 2025), explanation shown 3 s before the event (Du et al. 2019).

properties.name: Path visibility
properties.description: How strongly the car's planned path is drawn on the road.
properties.screening_note: Trust effect flips sign across studies; experts disagreed most (SD 0.26).

properties.name: Path width
properties.description: How wide the planned path is drawn.
properties.source: Jansen et al. 2025 (CHI); Colley et al. 2023 (IMWUT)

properties.name: Path length
properties.description: How far ahead the planned path is shown.
properties.source: Gap: never varied; 'too short' complaints in Colley et al. 2023 (IMWUT)

properties.name: Path style
properties.description: Whether the path is a plain band or carries arrows that flow forward.
properties.source: Gap: chevrons suggested, untested; Kunze et al. 2018 (AutomotiveUI) on animation

properties.name: Path certainty colour
properties.description: Whether the path changes colour further ahead, where the car is less certain.
properties.source: Colley et al. 2023 (IMWUT, 10.1145/3631408); Kunze et al. 2018/2019

properties.name: Manoeuvre cue
properties.description: An icon and short text naming the car's next manoeuvre.
properties.source: Requested by participants in Colley et al. 2023 (IMWUT); Häuslschmid et al. 2017 (IUI)
properties.screening_note: Untested gap; needs a scene with a manoeuvre text.

properties.name: Highlight strength
properties.description: How strongly the road users the car reacts to are highlighted.
properties.source: Jansen et al. 2025 (CHI): experts about 0.23, users above 0.7

properties.name: Which road users are highlighted
properties.description: Only the road users the car reacts to, or every road user it detects.
properties.low: Only those the car reacts to
properties.source: Colley et al. 2021 (CHI); Wintersberger et al. 2020; Jansen et al. 2025 (TR-F)

properties.name: Highlight style
properties.description: How the road users are marked.
properties.source: Tran et al. 2025 (ICAT-EGVE, abstract only); Colley et al. 2020
properties.screening_note: Scenario-dependent best style; categorical, screen only.

properties.name: Colour by road-user type
properties.description: Whether pedestrians and vehicles are highlighted in different colours.
properties.source: Jansen et al. 2025 (TR-F) 'color-coded chaos' complaints; OptiCarVis avoided colour
properties.screening_note: Both clips show all road users at a stronger highlight (0.5) so the colours are visible; they differ only in colour.

properties.name: Pedestrian marker size
properties.description: Size of the marker above pedestrians.
properties.source: Jansen et al. 2025 (CHI) range 0.1-0.2; Colley et al. 2020

properties.name: Other road users' paths
properties.description: Lines showing where moving road users are heading.
properties.source: Colley et al. 2022 (IMWUT): workload 12.40 vs 9.89, clutter 4.16 vs 2.53
properties.screening_note: Average cost but some users value it.

properties.name: Explanation detail
properties.description: How much the display says about why the car acts.
properties.source: Koo et al. 2015 (IJIDeM, 10.1007/s12008-014-0227-2); Hartwich et al. 2021

properties.name: When the display is shown
properties.description: Only around the event, or for the whole drive.
properties.source: Hartwich et al. 2021 (Front. Hum. Dyn., 10.3389/fhumd.2021.669030); Kim et al. 2023 (IMWUT)
properties.screening_note: Strongest evidence of trust-moderated preference; needs a clip with a distinct event.

properties.name: Confidence indicator
properties.description: A bar showing how confident the car is about what it sees.
properties.source: Beller et al. 2013; Kunze et al. 2019 (Ergonomics); Helldin et al. 2013

properties.name: Background dimming
properties.description: How much the parts of the scene that do not matter are darkened.
properties.source: Gap: untested

properties.name: Distance labels
properties.description: Distance in metres next to highlighted road users.
properties.source: Tran et al. 2025 (abstract only)

properties.name: Status panel
properties.description: Driving mode and speed shown on screen.
properties.source: Jansen et al. 2025 (CHI) vehicle status HUD

properties.name: Text panel position
properties.description: Where the explanation text appears on screen.
properties.source: Riegler et al. 2022

properties.name: Display placement
properties.description: Windshield (AR) or central screen.
properties.source: Colley et al. 2021 (CHI)
properties.screening_note: Fixed at AR windshield by consensus; not editable in a flat clip.

properties.name: Spoken explanations
properties.description: Explanations spoken aloud as well as shown.
properties.source: Pradhan et al. 2026 (technical report)
properties.screening_note: Not visual; crowd audio playback is uncontrolled.

properties.name: On-demand explanations
properties.description: Explanations only when the passenger asks.
properties.source: Frontiers in Psychology 2023
properties.screening_note: Needs interaction; a clip is passive.

properties.name: Before or after the action
properties.description: Whether the explanation comes before or after the car acts.
properties.source: Du et al. 2019 (TR-C); Haspiel et al. 2018
properties.screening_note: Fixed at before: after is no better than none.

properties.name: Path shape
properties.description: Single line, double line or cone.
properties.source: Colley et al. 2023 (IMWUT)
properties.screening_note: Fixed at single line: best understanding.

properties.name: Text size
properties.description: Size of all text in the display.
properties.source: ISO 15008 (excludes HUDs)
properties.screening_note: Only partly editable: participants' screens differ in size.
